by: the test surfaces that list the technique, whose predicates decide what a run of the technique shows
check.population: every surface that lists the technique, and the code those surfaces cover
check.freshness: a verdict stands until the technique, a surface that lists it or the covered code changes
check.refusal: the gate fails a surface that lists an unknown technique, and a technique that states no way it fails
check.observation: the technique's own runs, which locate failures; its fails field names the way it goes silent
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: one suite plants a surface that lists an unknown technique, another plants a technique that states no way it fails, and the bundled data validates clean
check.authority: the technique record, which every surface that lists it cites

records.principle: Reads structure and types for defects before execution
records.fails: Reports nothing when its rule never visits the construct, as with a misspelled visitor key

records.principle: Compares observed with expected results on an isolated unit
records.fails: Passes when the doubles that isolate the unit no longer behave like the real collaborators

records.principle: Compares observed with expected results across cooperating parts
records.fails: Passes on an environment that differs from production in the part that fails

records.principle: Compares observed with expected results on the whole system
records.fails: Is retried until it passes, so an intermittent failure is read as noise

records.principle: Asserts that an invariant holds across a generated input space
records.fails: Passes when the generator never produces the inputs that break the property

records.principle: Compares observed results with a reference implementation, the oracle
records.fails: Passes when the reference implementation shares the defect

records.principle: Compares an observed interface with an agreed contract
records.fails: Passes against a copy of the contract that drifted from the one the provider serves

records.principle: Checks boundary data against its declared shape at runtime
records.fails: Never runs on a path that reaches the core without crossing the boundary

records.principle: Checks a runtime condition against an assumed invariant
records.fails: Is compiled out or disabled in the build that runs in production

records.principle: Generates adversarial inputs to provoke unhandled failures
records.fails: Stops before the generated inputs reach the failing region, and the run reports no crash

records.principle: Projects behavior under expected demand
records.fails: Runs a workload shaped unlike real demand

records.principle: Projects behavior past its limits to expose timing and ordering defects
records.fails: Ends at a limit below the one production reaches

records.principle: Measures the distribution of execution cost
records.fails: Samples too coarsely to see a short, frequent cost

records.principle: Measures allocation and retention over time
records.fails: Measures a run too short for retention to show

records.principle: Describes the runtime flow across components
records.fails: Loses spans at an uninstrumented hop, and the trace reads as complete

records.principle: Induces a failure and observes the response
records.fails: Injects only the faults the developer anticipated

records.principle: Induces random failures and observes how the system recovers
records.fails: Runs where the dependency that fails in production is absent

records.principle: Proves that a property holds across the reachable state space
records.fails: Proves the model while the code drifts away from it

records.principle: Reproduces a run to isolate a non-deterministic cause
records.fails: Replays a recording that left out the source of the non-determinism

records.principle: Observes live behavior for deviations from normal
records.fails: Reports no deviation because the signal it watches was never emitted

records.principle: Introduces a deliberate defect and checks that the tests or the rule report it
records.fails: Counts a mutant as caught by a test that fails for an unrelated reason

records.principle: Reads back what was written and compares it with what was meant to be written
records.fails: Reads from a cache or a buffer instead of the store the write reached
